# Wikipedia

> > The free online encyclopedia that anyone can edit, featuring millions of articles across all fields of human knowledge.

Wikipedia is a collaborative, multilingual encyclopedia project operated by the Wikimedia Foundation, founded by Jimmy Wales and Larry Sanger. The English Wikipedia is the largest edition, covering topics from history and science to culture and current events.

## Key Topics

- Wikipedia
- Wikimedia Foundation
- Jimmy Wales
- Larry Sanger
- English Wikipedia
- Collaborative editing
- Free encyclopedia

- Open knowledge
- Verifiability
- Neutral point of view
- Featured articles
- Community governance
